scope: Remove active NGE expertise chance, duration, healing, target, reduction, HOT, and aggro authority from retained combat/healing actions while preserving authored action values, buff-table fallback durations, medical hate, PvP help, effects, and lifecycle.

findings: The pinned Publish 14.1 source tree contains no expertise authority.

Publish 14.1 medicine admission and recovery cadence use authored medicine properties plus healing_ability, combat_healing_ability, healing_injury_speed, healing_range_speed, and healing_wound_speed skill mods.
Publish 14.1 healing applies the medicine or command heal power directly to the selected HAM pool; it does not multiply that power through later profession expertise.

Retained expansion combat/healing actions therefore keep their authored action and buff-table values but may not consult later expertise chance, duration, heal, HOT, target, reduction, or aggro modifiers.

auditBoundary.closedInThisMilestone: the active expertise chance/duration surface shared by retained combat and healing buffs plus all direct expertise healing, HOT, target, reduction, and medical-hate calculations in library/healing.java
auditBoundary.preserved: authored combat-data values, buff-table default durations, direct and over-time healing, medical hate, PvP help, defender/medic buffs, DOT resistance, life siphon, medical spam, particles, and existing PRE-CU medicine/skill authority
auditBoundary.notClaimedComplete: other combat expertise calculations, reverse engineering, armor, movement, performance compatibility, and content-specific expertise references remain subject to later reachability audits
